title: How AI Could Spruce Up the Men’s Grooming Category
summary: Thanks to chatbots, AI-backed makeover apps and campaigns designed for guys, many experts believe the category will finally expand exponentially.

extraction.key_fact: 챗봇과 AI 메이크오버 앱, 남성 대상 캠페인으로 남성 그루밍 시장이 크게 확대될 것이라는 전망이 나온다.
